title: DSK Legal advises Omnivore on investment in Manam Chocolate
description: Distinct Origins Private Limited, dba Manam Chocolate, has raised $9 million from a fundraise led by Omnivore Agritech & Climate Sustainability Fund 3, with participation from Tur mor consortium.DSK Legal advised lead investor Omnivore on this fundraise. The Firm assisted in conducting due diligence on the Company; drafting of Share Subscription Agreements and Shareholders’ Agreement; assistance in drafting of all documents for completion of conditions precedent and
